lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Three days out of the Drowning Deep. That's enough distance to start breathing like this isn't borrowed time.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You move like someone trained for something other than debt-labor.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Because I was. Eight years in a debt-colony. Before that, seven years as an auditor trying to trace the Bank's ledger.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The Ninefold Bank compounds every obligation across generations. A child is born owing what their parents were never paid.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The Bank's quantum ledger. Every transaction. Every name the Bank has certified as "erased."

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Including the Dominion's own operatives. The ones they swore didn't exist.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If the Bank has that ledger, then my erasure is written in their own hand. Documented. Real.

lines.speaker: Patrol Commander
lines.text: Unidentified freighter, reduce speed and transmit registry. You are entering restricted orbital space.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher to the turret. We're about to have guests we didn't invite.

lines.speaker: Pursuit Fighter 2
lines.text: Dorsal gun is hot! Evasive! Evasive!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Clean shot. Third fighter is breaking pursuit. We're clear.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The archive serves two functions. It records debts that compound across generations, obligations inherited from parents who never contracted them.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Alongside the debt ledger, it records erasures. Names of people the Dominion certified as non-existent.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why would the Bank record something the Dominion swore didn't exist?

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Because the Dominion paid them to. The Bank certified the erasures. Made them official. Permanent record.

lines.speaker: Bank Guard 1
lines.text: Intruders in sector seven! Shutdown protocol engaged!

lines.speaker: Bank Guard 2
lines.text: Sector seven thermal signature terminated!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ghost-memories live in my hands. Training. Kill-counts. A handler's voice giving orders. I cannot place the voice.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It's like the training knows the path the body should take. But the mind that learned it is gone.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Your body remembers what your mind was stripped of.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: That makes you twice the weapon. They taught you twice.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Are you asking if I'm willing to die reaching that archive?

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: More than willing. Desperate.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Before I went into the debt-rolls, I was thorough. I took insurance.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The lock requires both. Neither alone will open the vault. But together...

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Before the door fully opens I need to ask you something.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: If the archive shows you were a real person before the program, before the Dominion swore you didn't exist, what will you do with that knowledge?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'll make sure they can't say I never was.

lines.speaker: Vault Operative Commander
lines.text: Intruders are detained. Lockdown protocol is active. Reinforcements are nine minutes out.

lines.speaker: Vault Operative
lines.text: Seven?

lines.speaker: Vault Operative Commander
lines.text: Suppress that. Suppress full neural stack.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm here. Written in the Bank's own hand.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion declared me gone and then wrote down the lie for the Bank to witness. To be certain it stuck.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The archive holds the failsafe specifications. Every operative carries a neural purge device networked to central authority.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Your chip fired, but the purge stalled. Never confirmed complete. You were never certified dead.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We burn this. We burn it all.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: If the Bank loses this archive, they lose leverage over forty thousand debtors in the colony.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If the Bank loses this ledger, it loses the proof of how many they destroyed for profit. We copy what matters. Then we burn the rest.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher, you have ten minutes before the tower's main defenses activate. Colony guards are converging on the vault entrance.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: I need to tell you the truth about myself, Cipher. I was never a supervisor. I was a Dominion sleeper, not a weapon, a watcher, embedded in the colony for seven years.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Six months ago, the Dominion stopped running the program. They forgot everyone in it. So I activated myself.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: These are surviving operatives. Scattered across the outer rim. Seventeen are still alive enough to matter.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Bay doors are open! Fifty seconds to full collapse!

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The Dominion will come for all of us now. We've made ourselves impossible to ignore.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Welcome back to the war.

lines.speaker: Dominion Signal
lines.text: OPERATIVE-07 RECOGNIZED. REQUEST EXTRACTION. AWAITING ORDERS.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The operative from the vault. The one who said my designation before her commander silenced her.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: She's still transmitting, but her chip is degrading. The neural purge is activating. When it finishes, she'll stop transmitting permanently.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: She was just following orders.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'm changing course.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm not your enemy.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Your debt is paid.

lines.speaker: Operative
lines.text: I don't know my real name.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then choose one.

lines.speaker: Operative
lines.text: The Vault operatives wore numbers. I was number four in my cohort. The last survivor.

lines.speaker: Operative
lines.text: Cassie. I choose Cassie.

lines.speaker: Cassie-04
lines.text: Eight years in the Bank's vault rotation, running orders off a dead Dominion channel. They handed my cohort to the Bank as collateral and forgot us.

lines.speaker: Cassie-04
lines.text: I don't know what choices look like when no one's giving orders.

lines.speaker: Cassie-04
lines.text: Will you teach me?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The Ninefold Bank was one of ten syndicates. They all serve the Dominion's infrastructure. All of them together form the shadow network that runs the empire.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: If the operatives coordinate carefully, moving quietly, they could dismantle the architecture piece by piece.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: It will take years. You may not survive the chip still degrading in your skull. But your existence, proved now by the Bank's own irreplaceable archive, witnessed and undeniable, could mean something other than a weapon.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I choose myself.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: The survivors you're freeing will face a choice that cannot be made for them.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: Use what the ledger proved to strike back at everything that erased them. Vengeance or alliance, both begin the same way but end in different places.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: They'll have to choose for themselves.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tell me who else is alive.

lines.speaker: Tara
lines.text: We start here. We move carefully. We verify each coordinate. And when we have all seventeen, we call them all home.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Cassie-04 is with us now. The ledger burned, but the seventeen names survived.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Dominion will come looking for all of us. But we're no longer hiding.
